settings.label: Main menu source
settings.info: Every menu category uses the same rule for every product. The page lists products in the Shopify collection with that name, plus products tagged with that name or collection:that-name, plus products whose product type is that name. Products with no photo and out-of-stock products stay off the page. A tag that does not name a category leaves the product where it already appears.

options.label: Jettribe menu built into the theme

settings.label: Show Google Translate
settings.info: This is a separate widget. Country language uses Shopify Translate and Adapt: add the language in Settings, Languages, publish it, then assign it to the country in Settings, Markets.

settings.label: Show VIP Deals in the menu
settings.info: Leave this off. Turn it on only while a VIP promotion is running.

settings.label: Show menu categories that have no products
settings.info: Leave this off to hide empty Outlet and other menu links. Turn it on when those categories are filled.

settings.content: The marks are PayPal, Visa, Discover, Mastercard, and American Express. They do not turn processing on. In Settings, Payments, enable Shopify Payments and PayPal.

settings.label: PayPal messages client id
settings.info: Messages only. This is the client id already used on jettribe.com product pages. It does not charge a card.

settings.label: PayPal merchant id
settings.info: Merchant id already used with PayPal Pay Later on jettribe.com.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.info: Used when a page does not have its own description.
settings.default: Jettribe personal watercraft gear: Coast Guard vests, wetsuits, goggles, gloves, boots, and PWC covers. Free USA shipping on orders of $400 or more.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: Paste only the content value from the Search Console HTML tag. Leave this blank until Google gives you the code.
